articles.title: Astronomers Discover a Mind-Bending Hybrid: The 'Black Hole Star'
articles.summary: A bizarre red object in the early universe has astronomers stumped. It looks like a star but shines 100 billion times brighter—impossible for normal fusion. The best explanation? A black hole wrapped in a giant gas cocoon.

articles.title: Curtain Call for Tako: The Piano-Playing Octopus Retires
articles.summary: After months of viral fame, Tako the octopus has retired from music. His owner, Mattias Krantz, built a custom pull-key piano and a crab elevator to train him. Now, Tako is resting in his tank as he nears the end of his short life.

articles.title: Dodo Myth Busted: The 'Dumb' Bird Was Smart and Possibly Nocturnal
articles.summary: New brain scans of dodo skulls reveal the bird wasn't stupid—its brain was proportional to its body, like a pigeon's. Even more surprising, its tiny optic lobe suggests it may have been active at night.
